bio: I am Abdul Talib, an AI-driven Automation Test Engineer, Automation Architect, and AI Product Builder with almost 5 years of experience building enterprise quality-engineering systems and AI-powered automation platforms across Infosys, PepsiCo, and Ulta Beauty. I specialize in Selenium, Appium, Playwright, Robot Framework, Python, UIAutomator2, XCUITest, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and CI/CD-integrated automation. My current work blends deep SDET execution with agentic AI architecture: LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, MCP, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, ChromaDB, Google ADK, BYOK architectures, LLM evaluation, and self-healing automation. I founded BugWizard AI, created RoboClaw AI Studio, and am building Ctrl Test AI to turn QA workflows, Robot Framework scripting, defect intelligence, and framework generation into faster, smarter product-quality systems.
